result.summary: This residential intersection features narrow, one-way streets with significant tree canopy, which likely encourages lower vehicle speeds. However, it lacks essential pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and clear sightlines at the corners due to dense vegetation.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection to alert drivers to pedestrian activity.

hazards.description: The lack of curb ramps creates a barrier for people with disabilities or strollers.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation at the corner may obscure pedestrians waiting to cross from approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Install Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint high-visibility crosswalks to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Construct ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install sloped curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim back bushes and low-hanging branches to improve visibility at the intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street corner with a sidewalk but no marked crosswalks or standard curb ramps. A large parked truck near the intersection creates a significant visual obstruction, potentially hiding pedestrians from oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A large white pickup truck is parked very close to the corner, blocking sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers on the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground, parked along the curb near the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate a pedestrian crossing area at this intersection, reducing driver awareness.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground roadway.

hazards.name: Non-compliant Curb Transition
hazards.description: The transition from the sidewalk to the street lacks a formal ADA-compliant curb ramp with tactile warnings, creating a barrier for those with mobility impairments.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground where the sidewalk meets the street.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install standard curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at the corner.

result.summary: The intersection features faded crosswalk markings and significant visual obstructions from mature trees and parked vehicles. While the residential setting suggests lower traffic speeds, the lack of clear pedestrian priority infrastructure and inconsistent sidewalk visibility create risks for people crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk lines are severely worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the foreground roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Dense vegetation and parked cars at the corner block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility for drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the travel lane.
